question: dame el número de pagos válidos por tipo de financiación de la tarjeta, ordenado de más a menos
sql:
SELECT p.payment_intent_id, d.funding_type, COUNT(*) as count_valid_payments
FROM v_payment_intent p
JOIN dim_card d ON p.customer_sk = d.customer_sk
WHERE p.eventually_approved = true AND p.is_test = false
GROUP BY d.funding_type
ORDER BY count_valid_payments DESC
